summary: iter343 frontend regression testing on BidVex preview. Ran BUG 1-6 UI verification. Result: BUG 1 (map popup detail_path routing) PASSES at frontend level. BUG 2 (homepage multi-lot card) FAILS — click sends navigate('/lots/ui343-multi') correctly but the MultiItemListingDetailPage triggers backend GET /api/multi-item-listings/ui343-multi which returns 500 (pydantic ValidationError: 5 missing required fields on seed), page then redirects to /lots. BUG 4 (admin per-lot editor) FAILS with an uncaught React runtime error ('Objects are not valid as a React child, found: {code, message_en, message_fr}') because AdminLotEditorModal renders the typed backend error object directly via toast.error — root cause is the same seed data 500 + a frontend defensive-string bug. Feature (star) button IS enabled on multi rows (part of BUG 4 passes). BUG 5 & 6 partly BLOCKED by broken seed data: /api/listings/ui343-single returns 500 (ValidationError: 2 missing fields), so /listing/ui343-single silently redirects (heart button, CostBreakdown, BidConfirmationDialog cannot be exercised). Vehicle detail page /vehicle-auctions/ui343-vehicle loads with a heart icon next to the title but that WatchlistButton has NO data-testid containing 'watch'. Storage detail /storage-auctions/ui343-storage renders only the navbar+footer — the storage listing content and WatchlistButton do not render, so BUG 5 storage part cannot be verified. Watchlist page /watchlist loads with 'You're not watching any items yet' (testbuyer had no rows). Smoke: homepage, /marketplace, /lots, /vehicle-auctions, /storage-auctions, /watchlist all load without crash except the two detail pages above.

critical.issue: Returns 500. Backend log: pydantic_core.ValidationError: 5 validation errors for MultiItemListing — seed doc for ui343-multi is missing 5 required fields. Directly blocks BUG 2 (homepage multi-lot card → /lots/ui343-multi redirects to /lots) and BUG 4 (admin lot editor modal crashes when it tries to render the error object).

Returns 500. Backend log: pydantic_core.ValidationError: 2 validation errors for Listing — seed doc missing 'location' (and one more). Blocks BUG 5 (watchlist heart on ui343-single) and BUG 6 (CostBreakdown quantity multiplier + BidConfirmationDialog quantity) — /listing/ui343-single silently redirects to /marketplace.

ui_bugs.issue: toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to load lots') — when backend returns typed error envelope {code, message_en, message_fr}, react-toastify passes the object as a child and crashes with 'Objects are not valid as a React child'. Should stringify: toast.error(typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : (detail?.message_en || 'Failed to load lots')).

Heart icon appears next to '2020 Mazda CX-5' title but the WatchlistButton has no data-testid containing 'watch' — the spec says a WatchlistButton must now exist and be identifiable next to the title. Automation cannot target it reliably; the visible heart may or may not be the working component.
ui_bugs.selector: next to h1 '2020 Mazda CX-5' at /vehicle-auctions/ui343-vehicle

ui_bugs.issue: Page renders only navbar + footer — the storage detail content (title, images, WatchlistButton) is not rendered. GET /api/storage-auctions/ui343-storage returns 200, so the component itself is failing to render the response. Cannot verify BUG 5 storage WatchlistButton.

Row shows 'Multi (0 lots)' but the auction actually has 2 lots (as confirmed by review request seed spec). Likely comes from the same broken multi-item-listings/{id} response — the listing summary API is probably feeding 0.

integration_issues.issue: Click on 'Warehouse Clearance — 2 Lots (UI test)' card in Ending Soon / Featured sections invokes navigate('/lots/ui343-multi'). The route exists, but MultiItemListingDetailPage.fetchListing hits /api/multi-item-listings/ui343-multi, receives 500, and executes navigate('/lots') in its catch block. Net effect: multi-lot card takes user to the Lots landing list, not the detail page.

/listing/ui343-single silently redirects to /marketplace (ListingDetailPage catches the 500 and falls back). Watchlist heart on marketplace listing detail cannot be reached, and the watchlist page shows empty state for testbuyer.
Cannot verify — /listing/ui343-single detail page does not render (seed data 500). Testids cb-quantity, cb-price-per-item, cb-hammer, bid-confirm-quantity untested.

action_items: URGENT — Re-seed ui343-multi with the 5 missing MultiItemListing required fields (check backend log: /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log for the exact list — 5 validation errors on GET /api/multi-item-listings/ui343-multi). Same for ui343-single — 2 missing fields including 'location'. This single fix unblocks BUG 2, BUG 4, BUG 5, BUG 6.

Harden AdminLotEditorModal.fetchLots() error handling (line 66): coerce detail to string before passing to toast.error — the backend now returns a typed {code, message_en, message_fr} envelope on 500s and passing it directly to sonner crashes the whole admin page. Same pattern is likely present in many other admin panels — audit calls to toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail).

Investigate StorageAuctionDetail rendering — /storage-auctions/ui343-storage returns 200 from API but the page body shows only navbar+footer. Component likely early-returns on a missing field. WatchlistButton verification requires this fix.

Add a data-testid to the VehicleDetailPage WatchlistButton (e.g. data-testid='watchlist-btn-<vehicle_id>') next to the title heart at ~line 1153 of VehicleDetailPage.js — the spec calls for a WatchlistButton next to the title and automation cannot verify without a stable selector.
Verify the Manage All Auctions 'Multi (N lots)' summary count — currently shows '0 lots' for ui343-multi. Once the seed 500 is fixed, confirm this displays '2 lots'.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLotEditorModal.js:66 — toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail) is unsafe against the platform-wide typed error envelope. The typed-error middleware returns {code, message_en, message_fr} on 500s; this must be normalized to a string at every toast.error/render site.

MultiItemListingDetailPage.js:229 and ListingDetailPage.js's catch-block redirect on error is UX-hostile: on a genuine 500 the user is silently teleported to a list page with only a small toast. Consider showing an error state so users (and testing agents) can diagnose the issue.

HomePage.getItemDetailPath() correctly prefers item.detail_path (returned by /api/carousel/* endpoints) — that logic is correct and matches the iter343 backend contract; the bug is purely on the detail-fetch side.

MapSearchPanel popup uses m.detail_path || `/listing/${m.id}` which is the correct pattern — verified via /api/marketplace/items/geo response which now includes detail_path for all 5 seed items (ui343-single→/listing, ui343-multi→/lots/, ui343-vehicle→/vehicle-auctions/, ui343-storage→/storage-auctions/, ui343-vml→/vehicle-multi-lot/).

Backend seed script for ui343-* appears to have drifted from the pydantic Listing/MultiItemListing schemas — the 21 backend regression tests the main agent references may be hitting different endpoints (e.g. carousel/marketplace search) that don't run the strict-model validation. Any test that returns individual documents from /api/listings/{id} or /api/multi-item-listings/{id} will 500.

rca of the issue: Root cause (BUG 2): seed ui343-multi in multi_item_listings collection is missing 5 required fields per the MultiItemListing pydantic model. GET /api/multi-item-listings/ui343-multi → 500 → MultiItemListingDetailPage.fetchListing catch → navigate('/lots'). Root cause (BUG 4): same seed 500 → AdminLotEditorModal.fetchLots catches and calls toast.error(e.response.data.detail) where detail is {code, message_en, message_fr}. Sonner renders the object → React 'Objects are not valid as a React child' crash. Reproduction: (a) as admin go to /admin, click 'Manage All Auctions' tab, then click 'Lots' button on Warehouse Clearance row (data-testid edit-lots-btn-ui343-multi); (b) as testbuyer visit https://prod-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com/listing/ui343-single — you'll silently be sent to /marketplace. Mitigation: (1) fix seed docs so pydantic passes; (2) audit every toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail) call for the typed-object hazard.
